entries.title: Learn-to-Play is not the exception-complete reference
entries.summary: Use this guide for first-game setup, core flow, and the additional/advanced overview. It explicitly separates a Rules Reference for detailed exceptions; do not answer card, combat, or team-rule edge cases from this package alone.

entries.title: Each round has assignment, command, and refresh
entries.summary: Resolve the round in three phases: assign leaders to missions, alternate command actions, then refresh leaders, draw, probe, advance time, and build/recruit as indicated. Repeat until a faction wins.

entries.title: Rebel assignment precedes Imperial assignment
entries.summary: During Assignment, the Rebel player assigns missions and leaders first; the Imperial player assigns afterward. Leaders left unassigned remain available for Command actions or opposition.

entries.title: Command alternates between revealing and activating
entries.summary: On a Command turn, choose either to reveal a mission using its assigned leader or activate a system with a leader from the pool to move units and potentially begin combat. Passing removes that player from later Command turns.

entries.title: Refresh advances both information and the clock
entries.summary: Refresh retrieves leaders and draws missions; the Imperial player launches probe droids, the Rebel player draws an objective, and the time marker advances. Recruitment/building follows only when the new time space shows the relevant icon.

entries.title: The factions win by different end conditions
entries.summary: The Empire wins immediately by conquering the hidden Rebel base system. The Rebels win when the reputation marker reaches the required time-track threshold, commonly through objectives; exact objective and advanced-rule interactions belong to the Rules Reference.

entries.title: Base location is secret information
entries.summary: During setup, the Rebel player secretly selects a base location after accounting for systems with Imperial units. The first-game recommendation avoids adjacency to Imperial units; do not expose the location while setting up.
